extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) 'species' labels had extra spaces (' Adelie', 'Adelie '), which were normalized to 'Adelie'; (2) 'island' label 'biscoe' was lowercase and normalized to 'Biscoe'; (3) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas (e.g. '3,450'), which was converted to numeric. All values were within valid ranges per the rules. The average body mass is 3,767.24 g for Adelie, 3,726.79 g for Chinstrap, and 4,895.83 g for Gentoo penguins.
